items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: And Ben and Jack would pick it up and we would go on, you know, and keep building

ctx.x: didn't do previous to that. And that style is what hung over to the Count Basie band, see.

But I was responsible for most all the riffs that the saxophone played. And sometimes Hot Lips Paige would come out and play on the end and play, maybe sometimes according to how he felt, he might play 50 choruses on the end of St. Louis Blues. And I would set a different pattern in each chorus. And Ben and Jack would pick it up and we would go on, you know, and keep building --
